verdict.rationale: Pigment has a dedicated official MCP server page, confirmed by probe. It says users can build and edit Pigment models directly from Claude, Cursor and Codex, and query business data from ChatGPT or Claude. Sessions are authenticated through enterprise identity, access is scoped by role, model or metric, and admins approve which assistants connect. Missing for 10: technical setup and endpoint documentation (exposed tool list, connection instructions), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as claimed.
